summary: claude-code reported NS-015 implemented (NOT verified): Municipalities (baladiyat) shipped as a 7th, non-nested partition: 338 OSM boundary=municipality relations (2026-10-16 extract, ODbL) clipped to the land, one overlap resolved (smaller wins), 97.86% land coverage, 0 overlap, 0 invalid geometries. Types, explorer, README (ticked, usage example, source credit), accuracy/reference/catalog/data-dictionary/methodology/usage docs, release ZIPs and tests updated. Version 1.1.0.
